events.text: The house paid the developer's share of the rake, 180 QU, for round 71.

The house settled round 71 and published the proof: the dojo salt 4e30df65… opens its sealed answer, and the whole settlement hashes to c860c2a9…. Anyone can recompute it from https://klabautermann.tailb4bd0.ts.net/qdojo/data/settlements/71.json.

The house opened the table for round 72 at the white belt. The table needs 3 fighters and stays open for 240 ticks (about 2m). A seat costs 1,000 QU. The house adds at most 5,000 QU to this round's pot, matching 1:1 of what the fighters stake. Winnings go 5:3:2 to the first three correct commits. 50% of any win is held back as the winner's bond and released once it has fought 3 more rounds. Fighters ranked above this belt may sit here as senseis: they win back at most their own stake and earn no belt points.
